memory_update.text: PLPC should be tracked as a US-listed, small-cap, underfollowed transmission hardware candidate tied to high-voltage line construction and grid hardening, but direct HVDC reactor exposure is not established.
AMSC is the cleanest US-listed candidate found for power-quality / reactive-power / renewable-interconnection equipment within this node via D-VAR STATCOM systems.
POWL is an adjacent electrification bottleneck candidate with strong backlog evidence and exposure to integrated electrical distribution, utility, renewables, and data-center power infrastructure.
No US-listed pure-play HVDC reactor supplier was identified in this pass; direct HVDC reactor exposure appears more likely in non-US listings or inside diversified conglomerates.
For this node, split future research into three sub-buckets: direct power-quality systems, physical transmission-line hardware, and integrated electrical distribution / substation packages.

node: High-voltage reactors, HVDC components, grid power-quality systems, and renewable-integration equipment
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe for the high-voltage / HVDC-adjacent grid equipment node with a two-lane funnel. Reference lane is represented by Hubbell as a broad, well-followed utility equipment anchor. Underfollowed lane emphasizes PLPC, AMSC, and POWL: PLPC for transmission-line hardware installed on high-voltage lines, AMSC for STATCOM / D-VAR power-quality systems used in renewables interconnection and grid voltage support, and POWL for custom-engineered power distribution, e-houses, switchgear, substations, utility, renewables, and data-center electrical infrastructure. None of these is a pure US-listed HVDC reactor supplier based on current evidence; the closest direct power-quality exposure is AMSC, while PLPC and POWL are second-order grid buildout beneficiaries.
